title: The Lighter Brief
overview: A pretty pleasant batch today: Jamaica has a new Rhodes Scholar with big plans for healthcare tech, the Latin Grammys delivered wins for Rosalía and Milo J, and the Chinese ambassador says businesses in Jamaica are feeling safer. There's also a Microsoft outage that gave some folks an unexpected breather, a tree-versus-billboard debate in Charlotte, and a fun stroll through history.

stories.headline: Meet Jamaica's 2027 Rhodes Scholar
stories.summary: Somesh Sharma, 22, from Ocho Rios, St Ann, was named Jamaica's 2027 Rhodes Scholar at King's House on Thursday. He'll head to Oxford to study medical physics and digital health, hoping to bring better medical technology back home. His interest grew from watching his grandmother struggle to get proper care after a heart attack.
key_facts: Graduated from UWI Mona in medical physics with first-class honours
Will pursue an MSc in Medical Physics with Radiobiology and Applied Digital Health at Oxford
Won on his first try, from a competitive group of candidates
Built free apps including Yaad Bites and an Outbreak Tracker with about 5,000 users in 40 countries
stories.why: A young person with a clear plan to give back is a lovely thing to root for, and he graciously said he wished there were more awards for his fellow finalists.
